clipboard_write.desc: Write text to the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows).

params.text: The text to copy to the clipboard.

clipboard_read.desc: Read text from the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows). Returns the current clipboard contents.

http_request.desc: Make an HTTP request. Returns status code, response body (JSON auto-pretty-printed), and timing. Cross-platform — prefer this over running curl/wget via run_command.

params.method: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS. Default: GET.
params.headers: Request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.
params.body: Request body. For JSON APIs, pass a JSON string.
params.include_response_headers: Include response headers in output. Default: false.

list_processes.desc: List running processes with PID, name, CPU/memory usage, and full command. Cross-platform — prefer this over running ps/tasklist via run_command. On POSIX (macOS/Linux) CPU and MEM are percentages from ps; on Windows CPU is total CPU time in seconds and MEM is working-set in MB — column headers reflect this automatically. Optionally filter by name.

params.filter: Case-insensitive substring to filter by name or command. Omit to list all.

get_system_info.desc: Return system resource snapshot: CPU model, core count, memory usage, and disk usage. Memory values are reported in KB.
